text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On one of my days off, I'm going<n>around town
gathering books and<n>other resources to use in Inari
One's<n>training, when...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, fancy seein' you here!<n>Wazzup? Doin'
some shoppin'?
choice_data_list: Something like that. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, fancy seein' you here!<n>Wazzup? Doin'
some shoppin'?
choice_data_list: Something like that. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya see, my old teammates are comin'<n>for a visit
soon, so I'm lookin' for<n>spots to take 'em. Gotta
make their<n>trip worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But man, talk about options! Every<n>place I go is
just as stylin' as the<n>last!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...That's it! You've got a good eye for<n>stuff, right?
You got any fav spots?<n>Mind takin' me to see
'em?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...That's it! You've got a good eye for<n>stuff, right?
You got any fav spots?<n>Mind takin' me to see
'em?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thanks a million! I knew I could<n>count on you,
Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thanks a million! I knew I could<n>count on you,
Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The hell's with this fancy parfait?!<n>There's even
flowers on it... Ohhh, is<n>this what they call
"aesthetic"?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Everyone's walkin' around in<n>their bathing
suits! And someone over<n>there is dancin'... It's
just like a<n>festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a pool hall, huh? I've watched a<n>few games
before, so let's see if I<n>can win in one shot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this place is pretty stylish too.<n>...Oh, whazzat
over there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Be right back, I'm gonna go check<n>this out!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Always careful to let me know where<n>she's going,
Inari One heads further<n>into the store. She's so
considerate<n>of others.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With her Oi teammates coming to<n>town, perhaps this
will be a chance<n>for her to let her hair down and
relax.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While Inari One takes a look around, I<n>decide to
browse the shop myself...

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I told you, it was broken when I got<n>home! Can't
you just let me<n>exchange it?

text_block_list.name: Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
But sir, it wasn't broken when we<n>wrapped it up
for you to take home.<n>Um... is it possible you
bumped it on<n>the way back?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That's when I happen upon a very<n>heated
discussion at the shop<n>register. The customer looks
like he<n>wants to grab the poor employee by<n>the
throat...
choice_data_list: (Inari's still on the other side of the store, right?)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As much as I want to help the<n>employee, I need to
make sure she<n>won't get caught up in any...
altercations. But seeing as she's out<n>of sight, I
decide to come to his aid.
choice_data_list: Hey, um, why don't we all just calm down...

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! The hell are you?! Mind your<n>own business
and scram! Or maybe...<n>you wanna take this
schmuck's<n>place and—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho there, big guy! Gotta say, I<n>like your
spunk! Ya look like you're<n>ready to trade punches!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just as the man turns his anger on<n>me, a tiny figure
enters the scene.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you got some complaints.<n>But ya know
what they say... Actions<n>speak louder than words!
C'mon, I<n>say you settle this the old-fashioned<n>way!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And the loser can't go cryin' home to<n>Mommy, got
it? Now, whatcha<n>thinkin'? A foot race? Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: W-wait, are you suggesting we fight?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What, ya worried or somethin'?<n>Don't sweat it, I'll
be your ref! I'll<n>make sure you settle this fair and
square!

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not looking for a fight. I just—ah,<n>urgh... Guess
I did lose my temper<n>there...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Izzat so? Guess I'll have to wait to<n>ref a street
brawl! Sorry for<n>misunderstandin'. You'll forgive
me,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The customer looks stunned as Inari<n>One flashes a
grin his way. He takes<n>a deep breath before
continuing... It<n>looks like he's finally calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
...Um, my bad. I bought this as a gift<n>for my
girlfriend, you see. Seeing it all<n>busted up just set
me off.

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I owe you all an apology... Sorry. And,<n>miss... thanks
for stopping me.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Boss, puttin' yourself in the<n>middle of that
spat sure took guts!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Boss, puttin' yourself in the<n>middle of that
spat sure took guts!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya coulda just ignored 'em, but ya<n>did the right
thing!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon, you're embarrassin' me!<n>Hehe, not
that I mind hearin' that<n>from you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If Inari One hadn't stepped in, things<n>might have
gotten ugly fast.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, the man calmed down, but<n>when I think
about what could have<n>happened if things had
taken a wrong<n>turn...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? Why're you starin'<n>like that?
There something on my<n>face?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who got us into trouble<n>this time, but I
do want to avoid<n>putting her in danger as much as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I was wondering why you<n>looked so
serious...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But you're talkin' to THE Inari One!And that should be my line!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're too nice, ya know that, Boss?<n>I get wantin'
to help, but ya didn't<n>have to do it alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're too nice, ya know that, Boss?<n>I get wantin'
to help, but ya didn't<n>have to do it alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're thinkin' 'bout what woulda<n>happened if that
guy tried fightin' me,<n>right? Well, my chances in a
fight are<n>a lot better than yours.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm an Umamusume, ya<n>know! I woulda
knocked that punk<n>into next week!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When you were lost, you had me help<n>you out,
right? And today, you helped<n>me out by showin'
me around.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm only sayin' this one more time,<n>so listen
up—You don't gotta do stuff<n>alone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If ya can, why not ask an expert for<n>their
assistance? There's a right tool<n>for every job,
right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, ya don't gotta be so serious...<n>Ah, looks like
the sun's callin' it a<n>day. We should do the same!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Boss, ya don't gotta be so serious...<n>Ah, looks like
the sun's callin' it a<n>day. We should do the same!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I get that you're as earnest as they<n>come, Boss.
Trust me, I know better<n>than anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I get that you're as earnest as they<n>come, Boss.
Trust me, I know better<n>than anyone.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(But wow, that attitude sure did get<n>you in trouble
today! Hehe, I better<n>keep my eye on you, or else!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya know, I think I'll tell the Oi girls<n>about today! Let
'em know ya gave<n>me a personal tour!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Inari One smiles as she gives me a<n>few more pats
on the back.
